question: What fixed inbound QQBot gateway message ceiling should OpenClaw intentionally support?
rationale: The dependency mechanism is correct, but selecting the permanent byte limit trades memory hardening against forced disconnects and possible message loss; the upstream QQ contract provides no authoritative maximum.

options.title: Use 16 MiB
options.body: Raise the cap to 16 MiB, retaining a substantial reduction from the 100 MiB dependency default while aligning with the compatibility-oriented Discord gateway precedent.

options.title: Keep 1 MiB
options.body: Accept the tighter boundary only with QQBot owner confirmation that legitimate production event envelopes cannot exceed it and record that contract beside the constant.

options.title: Wait for production evidence
options.body: Pause the PR until authenticated QQBot traffic samples or an upstream size guarantee establish a defensible smaller ceiling.

recommendation.title: Use 16 MiB
recommendation.body: Raise the cap to 16 MiB, retaining a substantial reduction from the 100 MiB dependency default while aligning with the compatibility-oriented Discord gateway precedent.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature history ties the QQBot gateway protocol and transport behavior most directly to this owner.
